title.en: Spacious indoor and outdoor play yards

text.en: Visitors describe the Harwood facility as remarkably clean and expansive, featuring large indoor play spaces and secure outdoor turf yards. Several clients note recent property renovations, such as new kennel suites, improved climate control, and summer splash pool days. Dog owners appreciate the ample space available for pets to run freely in safety.

title.en: Calm and engaging environment for dogs

text.en: Clients remark that their dogs sprint excitedly through the doors at drop-off and settle in comfortably for daycare or overnight stays. Pet parents praise the thorough temperament evaluations conducted before admission and the separation of small and large dogs. Owners of multiple pets also appreciate suite arrangements that let sibling dogs board together.

title.en: Welcoming handlers attentive to canine needs

text.en: Pet owners commend the kennel staff and on-site management for their warm greetings and attentive care. Reviewers emphasize that handlers quickly learn individual pet personalities and handle nervous or non-social dogs with gentle understanding. Daily summaries and friendly interactions provide reassurance throughout short and extended boarding stays.

q.en: Can multiple dogs from one family share a kennel suite?

a.en: Yes, clients confirm that sibling dogs can be boarded together in the same suite.

q.en: Is a temperament evaluation required before daycare admission?

a.en: Yes, the facility conducts a temperament assessment to evaluate each dog's social behavior and group fit.

q.en: Does the facility feature outdoor play areas?

a.en: Yes, the center offers large astroturf yards alongside indoor air-conditioned play zones.

q.en: Do owners receive updates during boarding stays?

a.en: Yes, daily photo updates and activity notes are provided to pet parents during daycare and boarding.
